sprint.title: One Deterministic Mundane Multi-Route Local Destination Resolver
sprint.goal: Resolve one local mundane destination route from static authored topology by fewest hops, then stable authored connection ordering.
acceptance_criteria: Multiple valid simple local routes select the fewest authored connections.
Equal-hop routes select the stable first route induced by existing authored connection ordering without player choice.
Route selection uses static authored topology only, preserves directionality, and does not treat hops as universal distance or travel time.
The selected movement_hops remains transient and provisional until sequential authoritative traversal completes it; save version remains 1.

focused_commands: Focused shortest-route and stable tie-break tests
Affected directionality, unreachable-route, sequential traversal, save/load, narration-context, and provider-safe regressions

governance: This owner-authorized capability package is active; no following sprint is authorized or staged.
Routing is local and mundane only; it creates no regional or wilderness routing policy.

No travel costs, edge weights, dynamic-state-aware routing, automatic rerouting, route-choice interaction, encounters, parser expansion, persistence change, migration, narration, or provider behavior is permitted.
Provider requests are forbidden and next_sprint remains null.

closeout.verification_result: Official preflight, canonical record validation, syntax checks, focused local-routing coverage, affected navigation, save/load, narration-context, and fake-transport provider-safe regressions passed.
